title: INVESTORBENCH: A Benchmark for Financial Decision-Making Tasks with LLM-based Agent

task.value: A benchmark for evaluating LLM-based agents on sequential financial decision-making (Buy/Sell/Hold) across stocks, cryptocurrencies and ETFs.
task.quote: we introduce InvestorBench, the first benchmark specifically designed for evaluating LLM-based agents in diverse financial decision-making contexts.

architecture.value: FinMem-based agent with Brain (LLM backbone), Perception, Profile, Memory (working memory with immediate/extended reflection plus layered long-term vector-store memory with decay), and Action modules; warm-up stage builds memory, then evaluation.
architecture.quote: InvestorBench includes an advanced LLM-based agent equipped with modules for Brain, Perception, Profile, Memory, and Action. This agent is enhanced with external tools (such as tabular data readers and API callers) and data operations (including vector database management, information reinforcement, and retrieval).

data.value: Daily data. Stocks: Yahoo Finance OHLCV, SEC 10-Q/10-K, news for MSFT, JNJ, UVV, HON, TSLA, AAPL, NIO. Crypto: CoinMarketCap OHLCV and crypto news for BTC, ETH. ETF: NIFTY dataset news headlines. Sentiment labels by gpt-3.5-turbo-0125.
data.quote: Stock market environment integrates information from multiple sources, including: 1) Daily stock open, high, low, close, and volume (OHLCV) data acquired from Yahoo Finance. 2) Summarized insights from company quarterly and annual reports (Form 10-Q and 10-K) downloaded from the SEC EDGAR database.

window.quote: For the single-asset trading tasks, the warm-up period of stock trading is from 2020-07-01 to 2020-09-30 and the test period is from 2020-10-01 to 2021-05-06.

models.value: 13 LLMs: gpt-4 (0613), gpt-4o (0806), gpt-o1-preview (0912), DeepSeek-v2 Lite, DeepSeek-llm 67B Chat, Yi-1.5-9b/34b Chat, Qwen2.5-7b/32b/72b Instruct, llama3.1-8b/70b Instruct, Palmyra-Fin 70B 32K; temperature 0.6.
models.quote: | gpt-4Achiam et al. (2023) | N/A | api | 0613 | Qwen2.5-7bQwen team (2024) | 7B | open | Instruct

baselines.value: Buy and Hold strategy for single-asset tasks (equal-weight portfolio mentioned for portfolio management); also comparison across backbone LLMs.
baselines.quote: For single equity tasks, the baseline is set up by Buy and Hold strategy, while for portfolio management task, it is set up by an equal-weight portfolio with the detailed rational explained in Appendix.

headline_result.value: Stock trading average across seven stocks (test 2020-10-01 to 2021-05-06): Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct CR 46.153%, SR 1.276; GPT-4 CR 43.696%, SR 0.972; Buy & Hold CR 34.099%, SR 0.732.

uncertainty.value: Five repeated epochs; reported the trajectory with median metrics (or median SR if medians differ across epochs). No confidence intervals reported.
uncertainty.quote: The performance metrics are reported for the test trajectory with the median CR, SR, AV, and MDD from five repeated epochs.

leakage_controls.value: During evaluation, access to future price data is restricted; agent relies only on historical data. Data split by date into warm-up and test sets. No discussion of LLM pretraining contamination.
leakage_controls.quote: during the evaluation stage, access to future price data is restricted, compelling the agent to rely solely on available historical data and its cognitive processing capabilities.

limitations.value: Only single-asset tasks, no portfolio management; copyright restrictions on financial data may compromise dataset quality and limit assessment.
limitations.quote: First, InvestorBench is currently focusing on single-asset financial decision-making task, without addressing multi-asset tasks such as portfolio management. Second, copyright restrictions on financial domain data may compromise the quality of the datasets we create, potentially limiting the assessment of model performance.

release.value: Three datasets released as open source under MIT license; no URL given in text.
release.quote: The data are shared under the MIT license, requiring users to adhere to its terms.
